headline: Petition by Eversource to install a pad mount transformer and underground conduit at 1400 State Street.
summary: The agenda lists one petition from Eversource. It asks to install a transformer and underground wiring at 1400 State Street.
items: Eversource petition to install one pad mount transformer and 20 feet of underground primary, secondary, and conduit at 1400 State Street, to provide power to customers and replace a failing spot network system.

Board of Public Works                                          1                                       Printed 10/22/2026 
 
 
                         BOARD OF PUBLIC WORKS       
  
                                Hearings Meeting Agenda 
   
  
I hereby notify you that the following items of business have been filed with this office and can

City Clerk  
 
Location 
1400 State Street Springfield, MA 
 
Petitions 
TO INSTALL (1) PAD MOUNT TRANSFORMER AND 20' OF UNDERGROUND
